scope: Independent public BTC-USDT network experiment; no AiQuant database or private trading

clientFrames.textPing: ping is forwarded to OKX; the relay never synthesizes the text pong

outgoingHeaders: Never forward probe credentials, cookies, Authorization or OK-ACCESS-* to OKX
network: Normal upstream Host/SNI/TLS, no proxy or insecure certificate option
lifecycle: Accept downstream WS only after upstream opens; disconnect tears down both sides; graceful shutdown; no outbound retry of side effects
logging: Counts/status/codes only; no headers, frame bodies, tokens, login data or account messages
deployment: Native free service only; verify zero-cost region and egress; platform hostname first; existing ws.aiquant.org.cn and production unchanged
